title: Sonata in G min
identity: Jean-Marie Leclair, Sonata in G minor, Southern Music SS788, arranged for alto saxophone by Peter Gorner. Hal Leonard’s official page lists 26 pages and its own Level 4 label. The exact source sonata and score contents were not established from the publisher page.

evidence.claim: Catalog lead identifies Southern SS788, movement names Prelude, Allemande, Sarabande, Minuette and Double, and optional repeats; the exact score was not accessed.

Hal Leonard’s official product page identifies Southern Music SS788 as an alto-saxophone edition arranged by Peter Gorner, 26 pages, labeled Level 4 by the publisher. This label is not a college-year recommendation.
evidence.source_name: Hal Leonard / Southern Music official product listing

evidence.claim: The Illinois Grade School Music Association’s required solo list, updated January 2016, places Leclair/Gorner, Sonata in G Minor in the E-flat alto saxophone Class A list. This documents a school contest-list placement and does not establish simplification or college suitability.
evidence.source_name: Illinois Grade School Music Association, Required Solo List 2015–17

review_focus: Compare the published saxophone part with the violin source, particularly repeats, ornamentation, and instrument-specific phrasing.
collection_flag: Publisher identifies an alto-saxophone arrangement by Peter Gorner. Its “Level 4” is the publisher’s label. IGSMA’s 2015–17 list includes Leclair/Gorner in an E-flat alto Class A contest list; that school placement does not establish simplification or exclude college use.

score_links.description: Official product metadata only; no score preview available.

gaps: The publisher page provides no public notation preview; the saxophone part and original-source match were not inspected.
No work-specific performance or college/professional programming verified.
